name: Document Structure Browser
description: Annotated tree browser: Expandable folder/file or JSON structure on the left, path, type, description and reproducible example of the selected item on the right.
scenarios: Explain the field structure of the page file (.showai.json)
Describes the directory layout of a component package, template folder, or content library
A step-by-step explanation of the fields in a configuration file or API return value

boundaries: Used for hierarchical structures that need to be explained item by item in ShowAI documents: folder layout, JSON fields, and configuration items.

It is recommended that the total number of items should not exceed 60 and the level should not exceed 6 levels; larger structures should be split into several trees, or only the parts needed by readers should be displayed.
Read-only display: Expanding and selecting only change the local view and do not modify the page data.

usage.purpose: Let readers look and check the structure: see the overall shape on the left, select any item and read what it is, what type it is, and how to write it on the right.
structure: Tree on the left: collapse arrow, icons by kind (folder, file, {} object, [ ] array, field), name, type in monospaced font, and logo on the right; thin guide lines between levels.

Details on the right: path (you can click on the ancestor to return), name and type, category and number of sub-items, summary, detail (inline markers, blank line segments, lines starting with "-" become a list), sample code with a copy button, and a clickable sub-item list.
Details appear below the tree when width is less than 640px.

inputs.meaning: Top-level nodes, in order of display.
Node name, such as a file name, folder name (can have a trailing /), or field name. Paths consist of level names concatenated with / (remove the trailing /).
The node type determines the type text in the icon and details: dir folder, file file, object object, array array, field field.

omission.description: When there are children, it is regarded as dir, otherwise it is regarded as file.

inputs.meaning: Type or format, shown after the name in a fixed-width font, for example, string, "page" | "board", JSON.
Short logos such as required, optional, entry. No more than 16 characters, 2–4 Chinese characters recommended.
One-sentence description, displayed at the top of details and in the parent node's child list; supports inline markup.

omission.description: Details do not show summaries; subitem lists only show names.

inputs.meaning: For more instructions, support **bold**,`代码`, [link](href); blank lines are segmented, and the paragraphs starting with "-" in each line are displayed as a list.
Sample code, displayed as-is in the code panel with a copy button.

omission.description: The code panel is not displayed.

inputs.meaning: Sample language tags, displayed in the upper left corner of the code panel, such as json, tsx, sh.
Child nodes have the same structure as nodes and can continue to be nested.

omission.description: Leaf node: There is no collapse arrow, and the child list is not displayed in the details.

inputs.meaning: Whether to initially expand (only valid for items with child nodes). Readers can expand or collapse it at any time.

omission.description: Put away. The ancestors of initial and initial itself are always expanded; without initial and without any open the first top-level node is expanded.

inputs.meaning: The path of the initial selection: the names of each level are connected with /, for example, document/content. The item and all its ancestors are expanded.

omission.description: Select the first top-level node. The same process occurs when the path does not exist, and the initialResolved of readData is false.

inputs.meaning: A line of description below the tree that supports inline markup and document links.

recipes.title: Explain a JSON structure
steps: Only keep the fields that readers need to understand; top-level fields are written in nodes, and nested fields are written in children.
Use kind object for objects, array for arrays, and field for leaf fields; type writes the type or optional value.
Required/optional are written in badge; write a summary for each item, and add detail and example for complex fields.
Write the path of the field worth looking at first into initial, and use readData to confirm that initialResolved is true.

recipes.title: Describe a folder layout
steps: The folder uses kind dir (the name can have a trailing /), and the file uses kind file, type writing format.
Folders that require readers to see the content first are set to open: true.

interactions.action: Click on an item in the tree
interactions.effect: Select and display the description on the right; click the collapsed folder/object to expand it at the same time, click the selected item again to collapse it.
Only expand or collapse the selected items without changing them.
Moves the selection between visible items.
Expand or go to first child / Collapse or go back to parent.
Expand or collapse the current item.

interactions.action: Click on an ancestor in a path or an item in a list of children
interactions.effect: Select the item and expand its ancestors.
Copy the example; the sandbox prohibits copying when selecting code and prompting you to press ⌘C / Ctrl+C.

constraints: Reading operations do not modify page data.
The name under the same parent node should be unique; if there is a duplicate name, the path of the latter will be suffixed with ~2 and ~3.
Do not use internal scrolling areas: When the tree is fully expanded, the height increases with the content, so the scale should be controlled.

data: To add or delete nodes, you only need to modify nodes / children; after changing the name, the initial will be updated simultaneously.
implementation: Adding new node types requires a new version, and adding icons and names to KindIcon and KIND_LABEL.

entryPoints.purpose: Components, path index index(), keyboard navigation, details panel, CodePanel copy, md() / mdBlock() and readData.
Design tokens (including dark colors), tree rows and guide lines, icons, details and code panels, narrow screen stacking.

architecture: index() expands nested nodes into a path-keyed Map, recording depth, parent path, category, and child path; the visible list is calculated from the expanded set.
The tree adopts WAI-ARIA tree mode: role=tree/treeitem, aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected. The selected item is the only Tab stop point (roving tabindex), and the selection follows the focus.
The copy button first executes execCommand('copy') with a hidden textarea. If it fails, the code text is selected and prompted for manual copying.
extensionPoints: The category icon is drawn in KindIcon; the child item list and empty state of the details area are both in DocTree.
invariants: The component does not call onChange; all interactions only change local state.
Do not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML; inline markup is generated by md() React elements.
verification: Example 0: The initial document/content is parsed successfully, document and content are expanded, and the details display the JSON example and 3 sub-items.
Keyboard: ↓ moves to the next item, → expands, ← returns to the parent item, Enter collapses; Tab only stops on the selected item.
Check out the tree, leader lines, logo and code panel at 1000 px, 390 px with dark theme.

nodes.name: format
nodes.summary: Fixed to `showai `, indicating that this is the ShowAI page file.

nodes.name: version
nodes.summary: File format version. The new file is written to 3; the old files of versions 1 and 2 can still be read. After reading, press Page / Board to adapt.

nodes.name: document
nodes.summary: The page itself: metadata plus a root container.
nodes.detail: Metadata includes `title `,`icon `,`cover `,`parentId `(in the project folder),`createdAt `/`updatedAt `, etc. The title is metadata and is not included in the text.

children.name: id
children.summary: Resource ID that identifies this file. It is not the same thing as `attrs.id `of the root container.

children.name: title
children.summary: Page title, displayed at the top of the page and in the table of contents.

children.name: icon
children.summary: The page icon, usually an emoji.

children.name: content
children.summary: Root container: a Page or a Board, the text is in its `content `.
children.detail:
`attrs.kind `is `page `(content arranged in order) or `board `(freely placed canvas), **New resources default to Page**.

All non-text nodes (including containers) have a unique and stable `attrs.id `; containers can be nested, see [Page and Board](doc:page-board) for details.

children.name: type
children.summary: Fixed to `surface `.

children.name: attrs
children.summary: Container properties.

children.name: id
children.summary: Container ID, unique and stable within the entire file.

children.name: kind
children.summary: Container type.

children.name: name
children.summary: Container name, displayed on the module title when nested.

children.name: content
children.summary: Blocks of content in a container, arranged in reading order.

children.name: paragraph
children.summary: Paragraph: It consists of `text `nodes, and the text can be marked with bold, code, link, etc.
children.detail: Write `content: []`for an empty paragraph; **Empty text nodes are invalid**. Links only accept HTTP(S),`mailto:`,`tel:`or in-page anchors.

children.name: widget
children.summary: Component block: Both built-in and custom components use the same shell.
children.detail: `attrs.kind `is the component type; the type of custom React component is fixed to `custom `, and the specific component is specified by `attrs.data `.

children.name: attrs
children.summary: Component block properties.

children.name: id
children.summary: Block ID used by `--blocks `to select content when exporting.

children.name: kind
children.summary: Component type. Built-in components have their own names, such as `mindmap `,`g2-bar `.

children.name: data
children.summary: Custom component reference: which component, which version, and what parameters are passed in.

children.name: componentId
children.summary: Component ID: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

children.name: version
children.summary: The **exact** semantic version, such as `1.0.0 `.

children.name: props
children.summary: The data passed to the component must meet the `props.schema.json `of this version.

children.name: integrity
children.summary: The expected compiled package hash, written by the service when saved.

nodes.name: layout
nodes.summary: The frames saved by the parent container for the child modules:`x `,`y `,`width `, and optionally `height `and `heightMode `.

nodes.name: surfaceViews
nodes.summary: The saved view and reading order of each container; by default, it is automatically completed when reading.

defaultData.caption: Click any item on the left to view the description; use ↑ ↓ to move, → to expand, ← to collapse. See [Page File Format](doc:file-format) for complete rules.

nodes.name: doc-compare/
nodes.summary: A component package is a folder, which is read as a whole when imported.
nodes.detail: Use `showai catalog import --input <文件夹>`to import the current project. The packages of the same `id `and `version `cannot be changed after being imported; the version number is increased when the implementation is modified.

children.name: manifest.json
children.summary: Component identity and description:`id `,`name `,`version `,`entry `, default data, examples and documentation.
children.detail:
-`id `: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
-`version `: precise semantic version
-`defaultData `and every `examples[].data `must pass props.schema.json
- New component provided `documentation `(version 2)

children.name: props.schema.json
children.summary: JSON Schema for component parameters; props in the page must satisfy it.
children.detail: Use `additionalProperties: false `to close undeclared fields so that both Agent and readers can find the meaning of each parameter.

children.name: index.tsx
children.summary: The default export component;`readData `can be additionally exported for the Agent to read derived data.
children.detail: The component received `{ data, readOnly, onChange }`. Only `react `,`react/jsx-runtime `,`react-dom/client `and files in the package can be imported.

children.name: style.css
children.summary: Component style, imported by index.tsx; provides both light and dark colors.
